prompts.starting-line: Create a NEW wide 16:9 illustrated cover image for a Chinese middle-school sports-science comic, without any lettering. Same single young humanoid robot as the project reference, with its rounded silver helmet, bold solid turquoise stripe, black horizontal visor with two cyan round eyes, slightly smiling mouth, side camera, white shell, dark waist plate and turquoise trims. A dynamic low angle FRONT three-quarters sprint toward us on a vermilion outdoor athletics track, planting one foot right at the beginning of a white painted curve. Impressive foreshortened fist/knee, anatomically coherent athletic stride with opposite arm forward, white curved lane markings recede on the LEFT, hard sunlight, cobalt-blue and turquoise shadows, stadium architecture and a few bleached clouds. Premium ink-on-paper French/Japanese sports manga, clean strong inked contours, flat spot color with restrained dark halftone, dynamic cropped framing. Compose the single robot primarily across the center and right half with breathing room on left. Convey the excitement and fragility of a very first race. Full bleed, no captions, no words, no lettering, no glyphs, no logo, no HUD, no watermark. Do not use the maintenance bay backdrop.
prompts.bend-panels: New ultra-wide landscape three-panel sequence for a beautifully designed youth science graphic novel, no words. Match the supplied robot: pearly white silver armor, turquoise crown stripe, cyan circular eyes behind black visor, compact friendly athletic humanoid. THREE clearly separated editorial comic panels of equal width divided by clean thin dark ink gutters. One continuous event from left to right, three camera distances. Left: macro profile of a single boot from this robot contacting a vivid red running track just after landing, visible contact shadow and clean painted white stripe. Center: tightly framed visor and the little camera on the temple looking forward, eyes attentive, red track and pale blue stadium out of focus. Right: robot's head-camera view looking down a red lane toward a very clear black and yellow striped LOW OVERHEAD CROSSBAR that one must crouch under; supported at both sides; knee perspective, track horizon, motion lines. Human-scale cues. Drawn in crisp hand-inked sports manga linework with flat color, restrained halftone in the shadows, kinetic framings, rich cream white highlights. Show only the event, no diagrams or arrows, no letters or symbols, no writing, no bubbles. Use all the image area with the three consecutive frames. Wide 16:9.
